news.title: Justice Department Seeks to Disqualify Judge Overseeing Golf Course Lawsuit
news.summary: Escalating a standoff with Judge Ana C. Reyes, the Justice Department demanded that she recuse herself from a case in which she had ordered several Trump officials to testify.
